title: 508 Compliance - Add Alt="" tag to decorative elements
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

508 reader applications use 'alt=""' tags to skip over decorative elements such as the down arrow at the end of a selectbox.  This is not implemented in the Streamlit widgets.

### Why?

Decorative images without alt tags create clutter in the object hierarchy readers such as JAWS create and can be confusing to sight-impaired users
